notes.name: Bayanzayan Hot Springs
notes.legend: A geothermal springs with naturally heated water that provide relaxation and medicinal benefits. Average temperature is 46°C.

notes.name: Atester Healing Spring
notes.legend: This legendary water source is whispered about in ancient tales and believed to possess mystical properties. The spring emanates crystal-clear water, shimmering with an otherworldly iridescence that sparkles even in the dimmest light.

notes.name: Atibeyli Bridge
notes.legend: An old crossing of the Totnesford River, rarely used since banditry infested the area.

notes.name: The Orange Badger
notes.legend: A big and famous roadside tavern. Delicious boiled teal with sparkling kumis is served here.

notes.name: The Bright Horse
notes.legend: A big and famous roadside inn. Delicious stewed eggplant with hot tea is served here.

notes.name: The Great Moose
notes.legend: A big and famous roadside inn. Delicious poached buffalo with yellow milk is served here.

notes.name: Shemmar Waterfall
notes.legend: The rapids of an exceptionally beautiful waterfall.

notes.name: Alcuthornala Battlefield
notes.legend:
A historical battle of the Pevagostis Conflict. 
Date: February 10, 1750 Lakshnur Era.

notes.name: Dungeon
notes.legend: Undiscovered dungeon. See One page dungeon

notes.name: Emeverguard Giant
notes.legend: Legends speak of a hungry Giant who inhabits Emeverguard hills and prefers eating children.

notes.name: Yelge Forest
notes.legend: A forest sacred to local Bozte Church.

notes.name: Aunser Pinery
notes.legend: A pinery sacred to local Harynfanthonese Deities.

notes.name: Therius Palm Grove
notes.legend: A palm grove sacred to local Eldar (Elfish) Gods.

notes.name: Matorus Crows
notes.legend: A gang of forest brigands.

notes.name: Ormstony Monolith
notes.legend:
An ancient monolith. It has an inscription, but no one can translate it:
༷༙༪༳༡༣༫༌༰༻༂༱༊༈༳༇༚༯༲༶༦༛༜༘༠༄༚༃༬༘༜༈༱༴༨༯༠༈ༀ༭༅༇༴༿ༀ༦༤༧༕༘༯ༀ༗༽༶༓༻༘༇༿༴༪

notes.name: Ruined Castle
notes.legend: Ruins of an ancient castle. Untold riches may lie within.

notes.name: Algerkhan Library
notes.legend: A vast collection of knowledge, including many rare and ancient tomes.

notes.name: Travelling Incomprehensible Circus
notes.legend: Roll up, roll up, this incomprehensible circus is here for a limited time only.

notes.name: Martens migration
notes.legend: A huge group of martens are migrating, whether part of their annual routine, or something more extraordinary.

notes.name: Batan Chasm
notes.legend: The Batan Chasm. Locals claim that it is totally empty.

notes.name: Aydilbey Portal
notes.legend: An element of the magic portal system connecting major city. The portals were installed centuries ago, but still work fine.

notes.name: Dustc Portal
notes.legend: An element of the magic portal system connecting major city. The portals were installed centuries ago, but still work fine.

notes.name: Pirk Portal

notes.name: Interdimensional Rift
notes.legend: A rumoured interdimensional rift in this area is causing nearby plants to wither and decay.

notes.name: Disturbed Burial
notes.legend: A burial site has been disturbed in this area, causing the dead to rise and attack the living.

notes.name: Mubric Cemetery
notes.legend: This ethereal necropolis seems suspended between the realms of the living and the dead. Wisps of mist dance around the tombstones, while haunting melodies linger in the air, commemorating the departed.
